intro.text: Spren seen only by people near death. They look like black, many-legged, fist-sized creatures with glowing red eyes, and whisper like tearing paper.

description.text: When Kaladin is close to death, Syl fights to protect him from them. To him she then looks like a solid figure of glowing light.
So few people survive seeing them that some think they are not real.
"Deathspren" is sometimes used as a way of talking about dying.
